da1_da2_code_of_conduct_note: DA1 counts the strings 'None' (9 rows, parsed as NaN by pandas) and 'No Code Of Conduct' (5 rows) as 'has code of conduct'; DA2 feature has_code_of_conduct counts them as absent.
interpretation: label is a deterministic, closed-form function of raw columns that are also DA2 model inputs (the models never see the composite scores themselves, but they see their ingredients)
